notes: DECISION: JobAdder publishes its J logomark only as PNG (Webflow favicons); no /brand, /press or /media-kit page, and app/id/support subdomains returned nothing usable. The vector here is the J of its own header wordmark, painted the logomark's blue. The reviewer should confirm that a letter taken from the wordmark and recoloured is acceptable as the logomark; the shapes match the PNG at 512px. Reads on both themes.
